Upstream LICENSE retained byte-for-byte; SHA256:
0382b0057770ca05e9c350a50aa3b1c1fea84da0bc81d723bf00b9aa841be58a

The upstream document explains its Apache-2.0/MIT transition and documentation terms. No license grant or copyright statement has been changed. Native packaging uses this pinned upstream text only when the exact published SDK crate omits its workspace license file; other missing licenses still fail packaging.
